overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Dynamic Cordoba 2 Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is perfect for spaces like basements, master baths, or fitness rooms. It features 7 strategically placed Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels that provide even, soothing heat to promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Crafted from Honey Dark Stain Canadian Hemlock wood, the Cordoba sauna also includes a chromotherapy lighting system and Bluetooth connectivity, ensuring a luxurious and personalized spa experience.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: Dynamic Saunas are constructed of environmentally-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood planks. Our saunas feature energy efficient Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels that help relax and rejuvenate the body. Dynamic Saunas can be installed on carpet or any indoor location including basements, master baths, walk in closets or can also be added to a fitness room.
